title: Partial Dependabot CodeQL Action updates violate immutable-pin and init/analyze consistency
title_de: Partielle Dependabot-CodeQL-Action-Updates verletzen Immutable-Pin- und Init/Analyze-Konsistenz
summary: The historical Dependabot PRs #48, #49, and #50 each updated one CodeQL Action component while leaving the registry at v4.37.0; exact-head validation proved immutable-pin and init/analyze failures. On c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6, prior commit 635b8f603f852cff10926cd6f5449e763f6194a4 already atomically pins all ten references and the registry to v4.37.1 SHA 7188fc363630916deb702c7fdcf4e481b751f97a. Revalidation confirms no remaining FND-PARENT-0018 defect; outcome is no_change.
summary_de: Die historischen Dependabot-PRs #48, #49 und #50 aktualisierten jeweils nur eine CodeQL-Action-Komponente, während die Registry auf v4.37.0 blieb; die Exact-Head-Validierung belegte Immutable-Pin- und Init/Analyze-Fehler. Auf c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6 pinnt der frühere Commit 635b8f603f852cff10926cd6f5449e763f6194a4 bereits alle zehn Referenzen und die Registry atomar auf v4.37.1-SHA 7188fc363630916deb702c7fdcf4e481b751f97a. Die Revalidierung bestätigt keinen verbleibenden FND-PARENT-0018-Defekt; das Ergebnis ist no_change.
observed_behavior: Historic exact PR heads failed because SHA 7188fc363630916deb702c7fdcf4e481b751f97a was absent from security-tools.lock.yml; #48 used init v4.37.0/analyze v4.37.1 and #50 used the inverse, each causing a CodeQL configuration/action version mismatch. Current revision c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6 has no mixed scoped reference and passes the focused immutable-pin contract.
observed_behavior_de: Historische exakte PR-Heads scheiterten, weil SHA 7188fc363630916deb702c7fdcf4e481b751f97a in security-tools.lock.yml fehlte; #48 verwendete init v4.37.0/analyze v4.37.1 und #50 die umgekehrte Richtung, jeweils mit einer CodeQL-Konfigurations-/Action-Versionsabweichung. Die aktuelle Revision c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6 enthält keine gemischte abgegrenzte Referenz und besteht den fokussierten Immutable-Pin-Vertrag.
expected_behavior: All CodeQL Action uses and the registry point to one official immutable release; contract and CodeQL jobs pass with existing controls unchanged.
expected_behavior_de: Alle CodeQL-Action-Verwendungen und die Registry zeigen auf ein offizielles unveränderliches Release; Vertrag und CodeQL-Jobs bestehen bei unveränderten bestehenden Kontrollen.
impact: An individual merge would produce a known-invalid CI-security configuration. This is a CI/supply-chain consistency defect, not a claimed connector-runtime exploit.
impact_de: Ein einzelnes Mergen würde eine bekannte ungültige CI-Security-Konfiguration erzeugen. Dies ist ein CI-/Supply-Chain-Konsistenzdefekt, kein behaupteter Connector-Runtime-Exploit.
preconditions: Only one CodeQL Action component is updated.
The immutable-action registry remains on the prior release.
CodeQL init and analyze resolve to different releases.
reproduction: Inspect exact original heads of PRs #48, #49, and #50.
Run CodeQL on init-only or analyze-only state.

evidence.command: Authorized GitHub Actions job-log retrieval for exact original heads of PRs #48, #49, and #50
RTK-mediated current-source inspection, make check-ci-security-contract, Actionlint, offline Zizmor, safe/unsafe fixtures, retained exact-head log comparison, and GitHub exact-SHA check inspection

RTK-proxied immutable-pin local controls, exact-head GitHub required-check/Sonar/thread audits, protected merges, resulting-master check-run readback, and public SonarQube Cloud quality-gate/hotspot readback for task-owned replacements #75 and #76.
evidence.summary: Analogous Dependabot PRs #67/#68 each lacked a matching immutable-action lock entry. Atomic task-owned replacements #75/#76 passed exact-head controls and were protected-squash merged; current master 2ade0d40983b7af21a65b8cd2884866b85626393 has successful Actions evidence. Its only failed check is the separate FND-SONAR-0001 baseline.

root_cause: Dependabot split one versioned security action release transaction into separate component PRs while the repository contract requires all ten refs and the registry entry to change together.
root_cause_de: Dependabot teilte eine Release-Transaktion einer versionierten Security-Action in getrennte Komponenten-PRs, während der Repository-Vertrag alle zehn Referenzen und den Registry-Eintrag gemeinsam verlangt.
proposed_remediation: No further source remediation is required at the selected revision. Preserve the existing atomic all-ten-reference and registry update in commit 635b8f603f852cff10926cd6f5449e763f6194a4; future updates must retain that invariant.
proposed_remediation_de: Auf der ausgewählten Revision ist keine weitere Source-Remediation erforderlich. Das bestehende atomare Update aller zehn Referenzen und der Registry in Commit 635b8f603f852cff10926cd6f5449e763f6194a4 ist zu bewahren; zukünftige Updates müssen diese Invariante erhalten.
acceptance_criteria: All ten refs and registry entry use SHA 7188fc363630916deb702c7fdcf4e481b751f97a with v4.37.1 comments.
Local immutable-pin, Actionlint/ShellCheck, and Zizmor controls pass, including safe and unsafe Zizmor controls.
Replacement PR #52 exact-head CodeQL, Actions, and SonarQube Cloud evidence is successful; current master CodeQL checks are successful.
Any current master SonarQube Cloud failure is explicitly shown to be the separate pre-existing FND-SONAR-0001 condition.
No permission, trigger, matrix, scanner, Quality Gate, protection, PR #51, Framework, MRTS, or gitlink change is introduced during revalidation.
validation_plan: Inspect the selected current source and the atomic replacement commit for the all-ten-reference invariant.
Run current immutable-pin, Actionlint/ShellCheck, Zizmor, safe/unsafe fixture, and retained exact-head control evidence.
Classify CodeQL and SonarQube Cloud evidence by exact SHA and ownership; do not expand into FND-SONAR-0001 remediation.
legitimate_control_tests: Full atomic v4.37.1 update passes immutable-pin contract.
Safe Zizmor fixture accepts; insecure fixture rejects (observed exit 14).
CodeQL init and analyze use v4.37.1 together.
residual_risk: FND-PARENT-0018 has no remaining current-source defect. The official v4.37.1 tag is reported unsigned, so provenance remains limited to the official repository, release, tag target, and full SHA. FND-SONAR-0001 remains open and blocked with its own release-blocking SonarQube Cloud condition; this closure neither changes nor dispositions it. No risk accepted.
residual_risk_de: FND-PARENT-0018 hat keinen verbleibenden Current-Source-Defekt. Das offizielle v4.37.1-Tag wird als unsigned gemeldet; Provenienz bleibt auf offizielles Repository, Release, Tag-Ziel und vollständigen SHA begrenzt. FND-SONAR-0001 bleibt mit seinem eigenen release-blockierenden SonarQube-Cloud-Zustand offen und blockiert; dieser Abschluss ändert oder dispositioniert ihn nicht. Kein Risiko akzeptiert.

history.detail: Eleven PR #48-#50 failed job logs retained and classified.
Local contract, actionlint/ShellCheck, Zizmor, and scoped-diff controls passed; exact PR/master evidence pending.

At c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6, prior commit 635b8f603f852cff10926cd6f5449e763f6194a4 already atomically pins all ten CodeQL Action references and the registry to v4.37.1 SHA 7188fc363630916deb702c7fdcf4e481b751f97a. Focused local controls passed; retained PR #48/#50 logs prove both historical mixed-version directions; current master CodeQL checks passed. Current master SonarQube Cloud failure is the separately tracked pre-existing FND-SONAR-0001 condition. No product change was made.

Closure follows the recorded verified state: exact original PR #48/#50 evidence, merged replacement PR #52, current master SHA c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6, current CodeQL/Actions evidence, and legitimate controls are retained. Outcome remains no_change; final disposition is already_fixed_on_current_master. No product change, commit, push, or PR is required. The former worktree plan was reviewed at SHA-256 3d6cd95176279b513e1cc7f426a54a7f1feea4c263a84731f493518a0aea0e08 and is not retained because evidence/fnd-parent-0018-no-change-validation.md (SHA-256 728c55f02d52bc394207e81ccb79bbc47ecc89a39ed430b4b86b54f784cd0233) already preserves the source-to-sink proof, both mixed-version directions, current counterevidence, controls, PR #52/current CI evidence, Sonar separation, and no-delivery rationale. FND-SONAR-0001 remains open and blocked, unchanged by this closure.

The same atomic immutable-pin/lock-membership invariant recurred on Dependabot PRs #67 (actions/setup-python v7.0.0) and #68 (actions/checkout v7.0.1): each exact bot head lacked its matching reviewed lock entry. Task-owned replacement PRs #75 and #76 passed all six strict exact-head contexts, Sonar PR Quality Gates with zero new issues/hotspots, and zero-thread review controls, then protected-squash merged as masters 5c26ffb698a892ffe83b7aa1749a456eae10b956 and 2ade0d40983b7af21a65b8cd2884866b85626393. The latter has 15 successful Actions workflow runs and only the separate FND-SONAR-0001 Sonar baseline failure. Dependabot[bot] closed original PRs #67/#68 unmerged; this task did not. The historical CodeQL-specific no_change disposition remains unchanged.
